test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

There was an interesting article in the newspaper about the dangers to an environment.
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**to an environment**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of **indefinite article **"**an**" in the given sentence is incorrect.
 
• We use the definite article before **singular **or **plural noun**.
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the **definite article **"**the**" before the **singular noun **"**environment**".

**The correct sentence is**:* There was an interesting article in the newspaper about the dangers to **the**__** **environment.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
